old_value: {"id":"fedistract-xzkb.14","title":"Trait bounds on struct defs instead of impls","description":"WfResponse\u003cT: Serialize\u003e (writefreely_api.rs:50) and PaginatedResponse\u003cT: Serialize\u003e (funkwhale_api.rs:85) put Serialize bounds on the struct definition. Rust convention is bounds on impls, not struct defs. The current approach infects all uses: you can't store a WfResponse\u003cMyType\u003e in a variable, pass it to a function, or pattern-match it without MyType: Serialize, even if you never serialize it. Should be: struct WfResponse\u003cT\u003e { ... } with impl\u003cT: Serialize\u003e Serialize for WfResponse\u003cT\u003e. Also, WfResponse derives Serialize but not Deserialize, while WfError derives only Serialize -- asymmetric for a wire type.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-07-21T04:20:26.983362452Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-07-21T04:20:26.983362452Z","labels":["review"],"dependencies":[{"issue_id":"fedistract-xzkb.14","depends_on_id":"fedistract-xzkb","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-07-21T04:20:27.002315643Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","metadata":"{}"}]}
